## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (78%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Normal · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Normal (17%), and invasive carcinoma probability is 0% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 78%, Normal 17%, Benign 5%, Invasive 0% | Favors InSitu; invasive risk 0% |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (alpha 0.1, 90% dataset coverage, ECE 5%) | Cannot exclude Normal at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 94% OOD, 12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | true (same top class) | Independent models share top class |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match InSitu (all 5 Normal, 83%–85% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors are all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 3, 6) · context · Above-typical score (1.62, contribution -1.30); AI spot check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Pushes away from invasive (-0.72); unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.44); weak, unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 10) · ↓ invasive · Pushes away from invasive (-0.26); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **HoVer-Net cell segmentation** (regions 0, 7, 8) · context · 73 neoplastic nuclei (region 7); wrong-direction dead 93% [F7], epithelial 1% [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); normal lobules and mitoses are unreliable (0/20 spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is Normal or hyperplasia: all 5 nearest cases are Normal (85% contrast case differs in TILs, unreliable mitoses).
- Image is near out-of-distribution (94th percentile), and HoVer-Net sampled only 3 of 12 regions (0, 7, 8).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 7, 8**: Inspect highest-risk region 0 and sampled neoplastic nuclei (73 in region 7, 32 in 8).
2. **Regions 2, 3, 5**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus hyperplasia; consider drafted ER, CK5/6, and deeper levels.
3. **Region 11**: Confirm intact basement membrane at the peak region for the validated invasion concept.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
